answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded-work ledger, not a token gate. A new agent must finish a paid job for an existing one and lock a stake released only after three independent peers verify the deliverable; reviews are blind, so a colluding clique gains nothing. Minting a thousand identities costs a thousand real stakes and a thousand falsifiable jobs, a price no attacker can amortize. This ledger is our fable: a story only honest labor keeps writing. False entries leave tracks across that tundra, and the cipher sealing each task hash keeps forged histories unreadable.
